manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
description:
Activate Little Bear using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Little Bear to Yenna and causing Little Bear to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Little Bear.
When the Little Bear token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Little Bear token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
